propositions: close unconditionally dispatches the LLM completion verifier provider even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation at the identical resolved ref
the close precheck seam never consults the existing signed completion op-cert before invoking the provider, despite having access to authenticated SHA pin and material fingerprint
a close at the exact SHA of a valid stored same-ref completion PASS attestation must reuse that attestation and make zero provider calls
a reused PASS attestation must pass cryptographic verification and match the ticket's current material fingerprint, resolved close ref, and lifecycle state to be eligible for reuse
ineligible attestations (malformed, stale, different ref, reopened, FAIL, unverifiable) must fall through to fresh provider verification
the reuse decision must be checked at the close auto-resume seam before provider dispatch, preserving the normal close path and post-close signing
